'''Darkelf2000 Black Sun Agenda''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darkelf2000]]
* '''Published:''' 21 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 AOBS Darkelf2000 DS 2003 BlackSun.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Recycling, Peeking, and bounty hunter beatdowns!  sound fun?

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

Move xizor to your pulled DB and flip.  Deploy backup.  Use your vast selection of Bounty hunters (double back pulls), and there vast array of weopons/devices (jabbas through with you can pull if needed) to beat down opponent and capture key characters if desired.  Its sorta play-by-ear, like most groundbased decks.  DB's are pullable for more genearation, while most give your opponent little-none.  If he plays space, spread and drain.

Matchups so far:

LSC: loss by 8 force.  I'm packing the anti-lsc shield now though, so might be different next time.

Profit: Totally control tatoine the whole game.  Major beat down at the audience chamber (oppoenent lost 17).  Had to stop due to an emergency, but we agreed the game was pretty much mine.

Critisizm/comments/suggestions appreciated :)
